caption:
More ad spend doesn't fix a slow callback.

Research shows most service businesses take longer than an hour to answer a new lead. Only about 17% respond inside that first 60 minutes.

Double your budget and you send more leads into the same gap. You pay more to lose the same percentage.

Answer within 5 minutes instead and studies show close rates roughly double on leads you already paid for. No extra spend required.

Fix the leak before you pour in more water.

rationale: Bold-claim to-camera reels win hook rate for B2B audiences right now, and this contrarian 'fix the leak before the budget' POV is distinct from the prior ads-vs-systems and reviews-vs-speed contrarian posts already shipped.
